name: Drought
case_study: 2011–2017 California drought killed >100M trees in Sierra Nevada.

name: Wildfire
case_study: 2020 Australian bushfires burned 18.6M hectares, killed est. 3 billion animals.

name: Hard winter
description: Unusually deep snow and cold; herbivores starve, predators briefly thrive.
case_study: 1996–97 Yellowstone winter killed thousands of elk, fed wolves through spring.

name: Invasive species arrival
description: A non-native species establishes and disrupts food web.
case_study: Burmese python in the Everglades has reduced mammal sightings by >90%.

name: Apex predator removal
description: Top-down control disappears; mesopredator and herbivore release follows.
case_study: Wolf extirpation across most of US led to deer hyperabundance and forest browse damage.

name: Climate warming +2 °C
description: Range shifts, phenology mismatches, ice loss.
case_study: Polar bear sea-ice habitat shrinking ~13% per decade.

name: Plastic pollution
description: Macro and microplastic accumulation in habitat and food web.
case_study: Great Pacific Garbage Patch; ingested microplastics now found in nearly all marine organisms.

name: Habitat loss 50%
description: Half of suitable habitat is converted (logging, agriculture, urbanization).
case_study: Amazon deforestation has cleared ~17% of original forest; tipping-point concerns at 25%.
